WITH osd AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    6371 * 2 * asin(
      sqrt(
        power(sin((radians(gc.geolocation_lat - gs.geolocation_lat) / 2)), 2)
        + cos(radians(gs.geolocation_lat)) * cos(radians(gc.geolocation_lat))
          * power(sin((radians(gc.geolocation_lng - gs.geolocation_lng) / 2)), 2)
      )
    ) AS dist_km
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
  JOIN geolocation gs ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = gs.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN customers cu ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id
  JOIN geolocation gc ON cu.customer_zip_code_prefix = gc.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
od AS (
  SELECT order_id, MIN(dist_km) AS distance_km
  FROM osd
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN od.distance_km <= 10 THEN '0-10'
    WHEN od.distance_km <= 50 THEN '10-50'
    WHEN od.distance_km <= 200 THEN '50-200'
    ELSE '>200'
  END AS bucket,
  ROUND(AVG(od.distance_km), 2) AS avg_dist,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)), 2) AS avg_delay,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS DATE)), 2) AS avg_act,
  ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt_deliv
FROM orders o
JOIN od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY cnt_deliv DESC;
